subject.title: fix(ollama): dripping model pulls hang past idle timeout during setup

question: Should Ollama setup treat 300 seconds without increasing aggregate completed bytes as a terminal pull failure, including during part retries and status-only finalization phases?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent and well-proven, but it intentionally converts previously unbounded valid-looking streams into setup failures; repository evidence cannot determine the desired compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve the semantic timeout
options.body: Accept the 300-second completed-based fail-closed contract and merge after the refreshed checks finish.

options.title: Broaden qualifying progress
options.body: Require status transitions or retry-aware completed changes to re-arm the watchdog before merge.

options.title: Retain current behavior
options.body: Decline the new compatibility contract and leave setup bounded only by header and byte-idle timeouts.

recommendation.title: Approve the semantic timeout
recommendation.body: Accept the 300-second completed-based fail-closed contract and merge after the refreshed checks finish.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and validated the Ollama onboarding and automatic model-pull behavior whose compatibility contract is changing.
